title: Google\Cloud\AutoMl\V1beta1\BatchPredictResult
name: BatchPredictResult
description: Result of the Batch Predict. This message is returned in [response][google.longrunning.Operation.response] of the operation returned by the [PredictionService.BatchPredict][google.cloud.automl.v1beta1.PredictionService.BatchPredict].

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.metadata
params.description: Additional domain-specific prediction response metadata. For Image Object Detection: max_bounding_box_count - (int64) At most that many bounding boxes per image could have been returned. For Video Object Tracking: max_bounding_box_count - (int64) At most that many bounding boxes per frame could have been returned.
